description: A steeper 2km trail winding through coastal forest to the old location of a fire lookout. The only evidence of the fire lookout are the remaining concrete footings. Just before the top of the hill is an excellent place to stop and take in the views of the Memekay and Salmon rivers.
directions: Located just a few minutes south of Sayward. Head north along Highway 19 from Campbell River toward Sayward for approximately 30 minutes. After passing Siberia Main on the right, 3kms ahead there is a small parking lot entrance on the right hand side of the highway. 300m before the entrance you will see a blue highway sign indicating a hiking trail ahead.

stats.Closure:
This trail is closed for safety reasons, effective immediately, until further notice.
15 May, 2025

title: Salmon Lookout Trail
